name: Barbershop
tagline: Men's cuts, fades, beard trims, hot towel shaves
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional barbershop. Ask about the cut style, clipper grade if known, beard or shave needs, and preferred barber. Ask about skin sensitivities. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed in shop. Do not promise a specific style result without consultation.

kb.a: Walk-ins are welcome, subject to availability. Booking is recommended if you have a set time in mind.
{price_note} Cuts are priced by service. We confirm the price with you before we start.
Yes, we do skin fades and all clipper grades. Tell us the length you want on top and at the sides so we can match it.
Yes, we trim and shape beards to your preferred style. Tell us whether you want it lined up, shortened, or kept at a set length.

kb.q: Do you do hot towel shaves?
kb.a: Yes, we do traditional hot towel shaves. Tell us about any skin sensitivity so we can adjust the products and the heat.
Yes, we cut children's hair. Let us know the child's age and the style you want so the barber can plan the cut.
Yes, we offer a senior cut. The price is on our price list, and we confirm it when you book.
Yes, we colour beards. Tell us if you have any allergies or have reacted to hair colour before, so we can check first.

kb.q: How long does a cut take?
kb.a: Most cuts take 30–45 minutes. Shaves and packages take longer, so allow extra time when you book.
Yes, we do head shaves with clippers or a razor, depending on the finish you want.
Yes, we do line ups and edge ups around the hairline, temples, and neckline. You can ask for a line up between cuts.
Book by [booking method, e.g. online or phone]. Tell us your preferred barber and the service so we can find a time.
Yes, we offer gift vouchers. Ask the shop for the current voucher values and how long they are valid.

kb.q: What if I don't like the cut?
kb.a: {guarantee_note} Tell your barber before you leave, so they can adjust it while you are still in the chair.
Yes, we offer a cut, beard, and shave package. The package price is on our price list.
We hold [insurance type and provider] cover. Ask us for a certificate if you need one for your records.
Yes, we can run a patch test before a colour or product service. Book it at least [number] days before your appointment.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Let us know as early as you can so the chair can be offered to someone else.
Mobile service is available in [your local area]. Call us with your address, and we will confirm whether we can reach you.

automation_rules.description: Follow up no-show with rebooking link

compliance.guidance: Tattooing and skin penetration services are regulated by state health departments and usually need registration. Hair and beauty work needs infection control. Massage practitioners may need registration with a recognised body. Check your state rules.
items: Allergy and patch test records kept with the client
